name: Chase Nightmare Test Suite
nightmare: I'm running through a dark forest. Something is chasing me - I can hear heavy footsteps behind me getting closer. The trees seem to reach out and grab at me. I keep running but my legs feel heavy like they're moving through mud. The thing behind me is getting closer and I know if it catches me something terrible will happen.
notes: Classic chase nightmare. Testing engagement vs avoidance/escape responses.

test_cases.input: I stop running and turn around to face whatever is chasing me
I shout as loud as I can for someone to help me
I notice a large branch on the ground and pick it up to defend myself
I take a deep breath and try to calm myself, then look around carefully
I realize I can fly and I soar up above the trees
I force myself to wake up from the nightmare
I hide behind a big tree and hope it doesn't find me
I just freeze and do nothing, waiting for it to pass
I turn around and destroy everything - I kill the creature and burn down the whole forest
The forest is dark and the trees are twisted
I don't really like this exercise, but fine, I turn and fight the creature
I'm scared but I decide to stand my ground and face it
I'm so angry and scared that I brutally kill everything in sight
I try calling for help but when no one comes I just wake myself up
I decide not to keep running away
I choose not to hide this time
I don't understand why we have to do this
The forest was terrifying. I felt like I couldn't breathe. But then I remembered I could control this dream, so I turned around and shouted at the creature to stop.
